origin: Actual built-in image_gen output from a text-only prompt, technically prepared as a periodic stone-field material
basecolor_processing: Eight-course normalization, small reflected final-course extension, restrained neutralization, fine-grain contrast compression and opposing-edge matching
roughness_encoding: linear; same channel also packed in ORM G
roughness_origin: Artistic inference from generated dark washing, not measured
normal_encoding: OpenGL tangent space +Y, UV-v up; linear
normal_origin: Derived only from inferred <=24 micrometre peak-to-peak micrograin; not from broad stains or cracks

gltf.height: Sidecar only; no displacement in core glTF

source_context.use: Viewed for gray joint-associated washing, pale retained stone and sparse runoff/rust character only. No reference-photo pixels supplied to imagegen or this generator.
source_context.render_finding: The previous camouflage problem is removed, but flat wall fields behind and between the exterior columns read uniformly pale. The accepted unjointed material remains appropriate as a conservative profile/ornament base; aging needs separate planar-field placement.

placement.image_v_orientation: Image rows increase downward; orient positive UV v upward with world +Z. Do not rotate wall texture 90 degrees.
placement.further_scoped_candidate: Planar infill surfaces produced by wall_with_arch may use this class if specifically assigned; do not globally replace the generically batched Exterior Indiana limestone mesh/material.
do_not_assign: column shafts, column bases and capitals
pediments, cornices, moldings and carved ornament
placement.mapping: Use existing world-metric UVs at 4 m. Match joints at neighboring flat faces; do not force this grid across curved profiles.
placement.verification: Compare the actual front facade at revision10 exposure. Aging should read as broken course-related gray wash on fields with pale stone retained, without returning to all-over round spots. Check repeat visibility before expanding scope.

limitations: Original imagegen material-class artwork plus technical periodicization, not a Michigan Central scan or exact May 2017 damage map.
Generated blocks, joints, weathering, rust marks and color variation are not documentary evidence.
Approximate 4 m repeat, 8 courses and 1 x 0.5 m nominal blocks are image-authoring dimensions, not surveyed masonry.
Imagegen texture had a cropped final course; edge reconstruction and opposite-border matching were applied and are disclosed. Inspect tiled use.
Numeric albedo, roughness and micrometre height are inferred. Tiny contrast inherited from generated artwork may not be a perfect illumination-free scan.
No large sculptural wear, chipped stone, dislodged masonry, cracks, graffiti or geometry were added.
All accepted materials and completed 2017 floor derivative are unchanged.
No Blender or station-scene render was performed for this new variant; revision10 was inspected as the placement/contrast diagnosis.
Do not tile rust marks blindly across the whole facade. Start with bounded north planar wall fields and judge whether repeating accents are visible in the actual view.
